key_idea: Children in the middle hold hands on both sides, so only the two ends need checking.
steps: There are 7 children. The 5 in the middle hold hands on both sides, so each of them uses the right hand. That makes 5.
The child on the far left has eyes, so faces you. That child's right hand is on your left, and it is free.
The child on the far right has no eyes, so faces away. That child's right hand is on your right, and it is free too.
So only the 5 children in the middle hold a hand with their right hand.

choice_feedback.A: Each of the 5 children in the middle uses both hands, so 5 right hands are holding.
choice_feedback.B: Each of the 5 children in the middle uses both hands, so 5 right hands are holding.
choice_feedback.D: Check the two end children: both have their right hand free.
choice_feedback.E: The two children at the ends each have one free hand, and it is the right hand.
